detail.longDescription:
I'm using the code below to play two songs back to back in one of my webpages. It's part of a digital birthday card. The issue is that after song1 plays, it's like the page is not able to either see the script, or see the second song. I'm not sure what is going on. Both songs are in the Music folder. What might I be missing? var player = document.getElementById("player"); var songs = [ "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/effacestudios/Royalty-Free-Music-Pack@master/Fury.mp3", "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/effacestudios/Royalty-Free-Music-Pack@master/Mysterious.mp3" ]; var current = 0; player.addEventListener("ended", function () { current = (current + 1) % songs.length; // wraps back to song 1 after song 2 player.src = songs[current]; player.play(); console.log('playing ' + current); });
Click play button to start
